overview: The Committee of the Whole convened to discuss litigation strategy and voted to enter executive session regarding a federal court case.

items.title: Call to Order
items.summary: President Zac Bears called the meeting to order and the clerk confirmed the presence of all seven council members.

items.title: Executive Session: Chertog v. City of Medford
items.summary: The Council voted to enter executive session to discuss strategy regarding the litigation of Chertog v. City of Medford, concluding that an open meeting would have a detrimental effect on the city's legal position.
